canopy.$description: Canopy — Primary brand — announcement bar, nav strip, primary CTA fill, section borders. The deep evergreen reads as institutional and environmental at once: it is the only saturated color the interface wears as a uniform, giving every page an authoritative dark-green header band

mint-pulse.$description: Mint Pulse — Accent / secondary action — vivid electric-mint button fill, eyebrow label text, decorative highlights. Against the forest-green chrome, mint reads as a switched-on LED; use it only where the UI needs to feel powered or selected

orb-violet.$description: Orb Violet — Decorative data accent — floating sphere fills, chart highlights, illustrated node markers. Violet is the only non-green chromatic and appears only on ornamental 3D orbs and chart accents, never on controls

cream-paper.$description: Cream Paper — Canvas / soft surface — primary page background on hero and section bands. Slightly warm so the page never reads as sterile white

sheet-white.$description: Sheet White — Card and elevated surface — product cards, dashboard mockups, nav bar. Stacked on Cream Paper to create a one-step surface lift without shadows

bark.$description: Bark — Body text and high-contrast headings — a near-black with the faintest green cast that ties the text to the brand forest

ink.$description: Ink — Maximum-contrast heading color — used for the largest display headlines where pure black is needed for presence

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary body text, muted labels, card sub-copy. Cool gray-green that sits one step down from Bark

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Dark UI text, footer copy, dense secondary lines

sage-mist.$description: Sage Mist — Hairline borders and dividers — card outlines, rule lines, table separators. The desaturated sage reads as an extension of the brand greens without competing with them

pale-sage.$description: Pale Sage — Lighter border for inputs and subtle separators

muted-slate.$description: Muted Slate — Tertiary text, helper copy, disabled link states

hero-wash.$description: Hero Wash — Mid-stop of hero gradient — pale lavender bridging sage to cream

dm-sans.$description: Sole brand typeface. Weight 300 carries display headlines (48-56px) — the light stroke weight is the signature restraint: headlines feel confident without shouting. Weight 400 holds all body and UI labels. Weight 500 is used for sub-headlines and stat values. Weight 700 is reserved for short uppercase eyebrow labels (e.g. 'HOW WE DELIVER RESULTS', 'ENTERPRISE SOLUTIONS') which get +0.07em tracking to function as section punctuation. The same family at all sizes keeps the typographic voice uniform across 10px micro-copy and 56px display.

helvetica.$description: Helvetica — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
